verification.scope: AC-1, AC-2, AC-3 focused update completion workflow; exposed a public receipt path missing its operation identity
same focused workflow after durable receipt-path projection; exposed over-broad generated-legacy adapter classification
same focused workflow after conservative repository-heading ambiguity classification
blocking review repair: reject dry-run operation resumption without changing callable state or writing a terminal receipt

deviations: The first authorized run exposed that the public receipt returned RippleGraph's call-relative artifact path; the repair now projects the durable repository-relative path containing the update operation ID.

The second run exposed that generated-legacy detection treated a repository-domain heading as safely replaceable when its line contained `.specdev`; the repair restricts generated adapters to known adapter or explicit SpecDev headings and fails other boundaries safely.

Blocking implementation review found that `--dry-run` bypassed the read-only branch when combined with `--operation`; the repair rejects that combination before callable resumption and adds state-and-artifact preservation coverage.
